text:
alex: Heads-up — seeing a slow but steady uptick of ECC/page-retire events on pool9/card11 over the last 72h. +3 page retires since Friday, small row-remap logs in telemetry. Can we triage before it becomes urgent?

devops-bot: alert: GPU ECC errors on pool9/card11 above 3σ baseline. 12h spike detected. dashboard: https://grafana.internal/gpu/errors?gpu=pool9.card11 :warning:

maria: thanks — pulling logs now. quick check: nvidia-smi shows increased retired pages. snippet: 
```
$ nvidia-smi --query-gpu=index,retired_pages count --format=csv
index, retired_pages
11, 10
```
Previous value from last week was 7.

leo: can you paste dmesg/kernel logs around the remap? Also which node is this on (pod/job impact)?

alex: node is pool9-node-03, running a mix of inference and batch. I ran a quick grep: 
```
[ 112233.445] NVRM: RmErr: remapping row at address 0x7f3a... (page retire event)
[ 112240.112] NVRM: Xid (PCIe) errors: 31 
```
No clear single large Xid storm, more like periodic small Xids.

maria: perf telemetry (from collector): row_remap_count: 4 -> 7 over 4 days, ecc_corrected_count spiked to 26 in 24h. Metric panels: https://grafana.internal/d/abcd/pool9-health

leo: sounds like creeping degradation. Impact so far: two short inference retries, no user-facing errors. Still, page retires usually precede full retire/drain. Suggest we cordon node and drain non-critical pods, run memtest and stress to confirm.

sre-oncall: agreed. Quick plan: 1) cordon pool9-node-03 now, 2) drain batch + low-priority inference pods, keep canaries for traffic tests, 3) run cuda-memtest + long-run reuse test, 4) if remap_count increases during tests or Xid rate > threshold, schedule RMA. If stable, re-enable with watch.

alex: ok will cordon now. drain command: 
```
kubectl cordon pool9-node-03 && kubectl drain pool9-node-03 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --pod-selector='!critical'
```

maria: starting memtest (run id: mt-184800). I'm running this script on node: 
```
#!/bin/bash
# run simple cuda memtest loop
for i in {1..50}; do ./cuda_memtest --gpu=11 --pattern=random --duration=300 || break; sleep 10; done
```

devops-bot: note: scheduled autoscaler will try to replace drained capacity with new instances in us-west1. Please monitor cost and spot replacements.

leo: during memtest, watch prometheus query: `sum(rate(gpu_ecc_corrected_total[5m])) by (gpu)` and `increase(gpu_retired_pages[1d])` — want to see if rates keep climbing. If retired_pages increases by >=2 we RMA.

maria: first run finished: no hard crashes, memtest returned warnings matching ECC corrections. remap_count went +1 (now 8).

alex: that's the trigger threshold we discussed — +1 in controlled test. I'm going to open hardware ticket and schedule replacement. Creating ticket now and tagging hw-team.

alex: hw-ticket: HW-6792 created — include node pool9-node-03, GPU 11, retired_pages=8, ecc_corrected=~30, logs attached. Assigning to @hw-team. ETA replacement ~48-72h depending on spare cards.

hw-team: acknowledged — we will prioritize. Please leave node cordoned and we can coordinate during maintenance window. If you want immediate hot-swap, escalate to oncall for approved downtime.

sre-oncall: set automation: annotate node with `gpu-fault:investigating` and add Slack alert watch for next 24h. Also add temporary routing policy to avoid scheduling latency-sensitive jobs to pool9.

alex: annotations applied. Also added quick watch: 
```
# prometheus alert mute rule for non-urgent jobs
alertmanager silence add --match 'gpu=\"pool9.card11\"' --starts=now --ends=now+24h --comment='investigating, cordoned'
```

maria: note for runbook: if remap_count increments again after replacement scheduled, escalate to full rack replacement. Logging runbook update: added steps and thresholds.

leo: thanks team. Follow-ups: confirm RMA once hw confirms, track cost for replacement instances, ensure canary tests post-replace. :thumbsup:

alex: summary: cordoned/drained, memtest triggered +1 remap, RMA ticket created HW-6792, node under watch. Will post update when hw schedules physical swap.

maria: leaving monitoring on overnight, will post any new remap events.

devops-bot: auto-update: node pool9-node-03 cordoned by alex at 1848004402. memtest mt-184800 completed. HW ticket HW-6792 created.

sre-oncall: closing loop for now. Reopen thread if remap_count increases or if Xid errors escalate. Thank you. :white_check_mark:
